value.signature: async fn commit < 'a > (& mut self , input : & 'a Retained , label : Option < & 'a str > , budget : ReadBudget , usage : & mut Usage ,) -> Result < ServerJudgement < 'a > , Error >

review.body: { result :: commit (self , input , label , budget , usage) . await }
review.item_premise: The result writer borrows caller-owned admitted public bytes, selections and label, and returns only public origin judgements after acknowledged wrapped COMMIT. Its protected Session is never formatted; closed statements carry bounded public fields, while row delivery, strict validation and every store-owned preparation allocation use one explicit allowance. Driver buffers are a declared trusted dependency outside that allowance. Local refusals roll back, and uncertain COMMIT returns no judgement. No executable persistence or further generation is enabled.
